title.fa: حکمرانی ولایتی در عهد ناصری از نگاه زندگی یک شاهزاده: عزالدوله
title.en: Provincial governorship under Naser al-Din Shah through one prince's career: Izz al-Dawla
title.nl: Provinciaal bestuur onder Naser al-Din Sjah: de loopbaan van prins Izz al-Dawla

summary.fa: زندگی‌نامهٔ عبدالصمد میرزا عزالدوله (پسر محمدشاه) که با یادداشت‌های روزانه و فرمان‌های خودش نوشته شده، نشان می‌دهد حکمرانی ولایتی قاجار در عمل چگونه می‌گذشت: انتصاب‌های زودهنگام، پیشکار به‌جای حاکم، جابه‌جایی‌های پیاپی و وابستگی به رضایت دربار.
summary.en: The biography of Abd al-Samad Mirza Izz al-Dawla (a son of Mohammad Shah), built from his own diaries and decrees, shows how Qajar provincial rule worked in practice: early appointments, a steward doing the real work, frequent rotation and dependence on court favour.
summary.nl: De biografie van prins Abd al-Samad Mirza Izz al-Dawla, gebaseerd op zijn dagboeken en decreten, laat zien hoe Qajar-bestuur in de provincies werkte: vroege benoemingen, een beheerder die het echte werk deed en wisselende gunst van het hof.

text.fa: عزالدوله طبق متن کتاب در حدود ۱۲۷۱ ق، در یازده‌سالگی، حاکم قزوین شد و کار اجرایی را پیشکار و وزیرش (حسنعلی خان) پیش می‌برد؛ ناصرالدین‌شاه در حاشیهٔ فرمان نوشته بود که حاکم نباید از نظر او سر بپیچد.
text.en: According to the book, around 1271 AH Izz al-Dawla became governor of Qazvin at about eleven, while his steward and vizier (Hasanali Khan) ran the administration; the shah's marginal note told the governor not to deviate from the steward's advice.
text.nl: According to the book, around 1271 AH Izz al-Dawla became governor of Qazvin at about eleven, while his steward and vizier (Hasanali Khan) ran the administration; the shah's marginal note told the governor not to deviate from the steward's advice.

text.fa: او در یادداشت‌هایش از بی‌کفایتی یا بی‌توجهی مربیان و وزیرانِ دوران نوجوانی شکایت می‌کند و می‌گوید بیشترِ وقتش به اسب‌سواری و شکار رفت؛ این شهادتِ خودِ اوست و نه گزارشی بی‌طرف.
text.en: In his diary he complains that the tutors and ministers of his youth were indifferent or self-serving and that his time went on riding and hunting; this is his own testimony, not a neutral account.
text.nl: In his diary he complains that the tutors and ministers of his youth were indifferent or self-serving and that his time went on riding and hunting; this is his own testimony, not a neutral account.

text.fa: در دورهٔ ناصرالدین‌شاه و مظفرالدین‌شاه به او دوازده حکومت داده شد (قزوین، همدان، بروجرد و بختیاری، زنجان/خمسه، ملایر و نهاوند، دوباره همدان و...) و بیشترشان کوتاه بود؛ بر پایهٔ همین کتاب فقط شش فرمان حکومتی از آن‌ها باقی مانده است.
text.en: Under Naser al-Din Shah and Mozaffar al-Din Shah he held twelve governorships (Qazvin, Hamadan, Borujerd and Bakhtiari lands, Zanjan/Khamseh, Malayer and Nahavand, Hamadan again, and others), most of them short; according to the book only six of the decrees survive.
text.nl: Under Naser al-Din Shah and Mozaffar al-Din Shah he held twelve governorships (Qazvin, Hamadan, Borujerd and Bakhtiari lands, Zanjan/Khamseh, Malayer and Nahavand, Hamadan again, and others), most of them short; according to the book only six of the decrees survive.

text.fa: مقرری سالانهٔ او تا ۱۲۷۷ ق پانصد تومان بود و پس از آن با فرمانی به هزار تومان رسید؛ هر سال نوروز برای تأیید ماندنش در پست، خلعتی (معمولاً یک جبه) از دربار می‌رسید و حاکم در مراسمی آن را می‌پوشید.
text.en: His annual allowance was 500 tomans until 1277 AH and was then raised to 1,000 by decree; each Nowruz a robe of honour (usually a coat) arrived from court as a sign that he stayed in post, and the governor put it on in a public ceremony.
text.nl: His annual allowance was 500 tomans until 1277 AH and was then raised to 1,000 by decree; each Nowruz a robe of honour (usually a coat) arrived from court as a sign that he stayed in post, and the governor put it on in a public ceremony.

text.fa: در ۱۲۷۲ ق «فتح‌نامهٔ» هرات به نام او به‌عنوان حاکم قزوین به ولایات فرستاده شد؛ یعنی حاکمِ خردسال در مراسم رسمیِ دولت نقش نمادین داشت.
text.en: In 1272 AH the proclamation of the capture of Herat was addressed to him as governor of Qazvin, showing the child governor's symbolic role in state ceremony.
text.nl: In 1272 AH the proclamation of the capture of Herat was addressed to him as governor of Qazvin, showing the child governor's symbolic role in state ceremony.

text.fa: مسعود سالور، گردآورندهٔ کتاب، از نوادگان‌اند و کتاب را از یادداشت‌های شخصی عزالدوله و خاطرات پسرانش نوشته؛ بنابراین رویکردش همدلانه است (مثلاً او ادعای عضویت عزالدوله در فراموش‌خانهٔ ملکم را رد می‌کند). پژوهش دانشگاهی دربارهٔ این ادعا و دربارهٔ فراموش‌خانه جداگانه باید سنجیده شود.
text.en: The editor, Masoud Salour, is a descendant and drew on Izz al-Dawla's private notes and his sons' memoirs, so the tone is sympathetic (for example he rejects the claim that the prince belonged to Malkam Khan's farāmūsh-khāna). Academic work on that claim and on the lodge must be weighed separately.
text.nl: The editor, Masoud Salour, is a descendant and drew on Izz al-Dawla's private notes and his sons' memoirs, so the tone is sympathetic (for example he rejects the claim that the prince belonged to Malkam Khan's farāmūsh-khāna). Academic work on that claim and on the lodge must be weighed separately.

text.fa: پژوهش‌های دانشگاهی دربارهٔ قاجار عموماً نشان می‌دهند که حکومت ولایات با پرداخت پیشکش و رضایت دربار جابه‌جا می‌شد و اقتدار واقعی حاکم به شبکهٔ پیشکار و خوانین محلی بستگی داشت؛ نمونهٔ عزالدوله با این تصویر هم‌خوان است.
text.en: Academic studies of the Qajars generally show that provincial posts changed hands through gifts and court favour and that a governor's real power depended on his steward and local notables; Izz al-Dawla's career fits that picture.
text.nl: Academic studies of the Qajars generally show that provincial posts changed hands through gifts and court favour and that a governor's real power depended on his steward and local notables; Izz al-Dawla's career fits that picture.
